lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters organized in vertical columns along the lateral flank, with spatial density increasing toward the dorsal region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance blobs to form a grid-like lattice of anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple longitudinal linear features on the upper flank characterized by a distinct luminance shift from light on the upper edge to shadow on the lower edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a high-density population of smaller high-luminance blobs distributed across its dorsal surface.
